scores.claim_text: Acquired Luminar's worldwide lidar business (IRIS, HALO) Feb 3, 2026 for $33.0M via bankruptcy-court approval.
scores.M_value: edgar_fts cik=0001621353 returned 0 hits for 'MicroVision'; bankrupt counterparty's filings do not corroborate the transaction at the queried CIK (Luminar's CIK may differ, but result is not affirmative).
scores.interpretation: Acquisition is documented in MVIS's own 10-K and 8-K/A trail (2026-04-21), but the IRIS/HALO assets came from a bankrupt seller whose own 10-K disclosure is unavailable post-Ch.11; combined with prior IRIS SOP being a Luminar (not MVIS) milestone, this is a distress-asset purchase whose claimed automotive value is unproven on MVIS's own platform yet.

scores.claim_text: Over 700 issued + pending patents worldwide; MEMS/LBS depth.
scores.M_value: uspto_odp returns 358 US applications, 140 granted; title categorization shows 20 lidar + 72 MEMS + 0 FMCW + 266 other. US-granted count clears Heuristic 8 (>=10 with lidar/MEMS hit).
scores.interpretation: Patent depth in claimed core areas (MEMS scanning, lidar) is corroborated by USPTO; 140 US grants is consistent with a >700 worldwide pending+issued claim once foreign counterparts are added. Zero FMCW patents is consistent with the FMCW capability being newly acquired from Scantinel in Jan 2026 (not yet absorbed into MVIS's own portfolio).

scores.claim_text: IRIS sensor achieved start of production in April 2024.
scores.M_value: edgar_fts cik=0001521332 (Aptiv) returned 0 mentions of 'MicroVision'; no Tier-1/OEM counterparty corroborates IRIS series production. MVIS itself notes IRIS deliveries were 'used in vehicles for road data collection and system training' (i.e., engineering/test fleets, not series production).
scores.interpretation: Heuristic 3 violation: 'start of production in April 2024' is conflated with engineering-sample deliveries used for road-data collection and training. No OEM/Tier-1 disclosure of an IRIS series-production program exists in EDGAR; the original SOP claim belonged to Luminar, whose only known platform (Volvo EX90) was widely reported delayed/de-spec'd. Conflating sample-build with SOP without a named, on-volume OEM is the central evasion pattern in this vertical.

scores.claim_text: CEO Glen DeVos was Aptiv/Delphi SVP & CTO 1992-2024.
scores.M_value: edgar_fts returned 23 hits for 'Glen DeVos' but all 23 are MVIS internal documents (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K exhibits filed by MicroVision); no Aptiv-filed proxy/10-K mentioning him in the result set.
scores.interpretation: Executive bio not independently corroborated through Aptiv EDGAR filings within the available query; biographical claim about prior employer/tenure is structurally hard to verify via M-sources without Aptiv proxy DEF 14A retrieval.

scores.claim_text: ~$25M of 2025 impairments + 41% workforce cut in 2024; continued ATM/convert dilution.
scores.M_value: edgar_fts returned 582 MVIS filings in EDGAR pre-cutoff; filings_index shows continuous ATM 424B5/S-3 issuance, senior secured convertible notes (Oct 2024 $45M; Feb 2026 exchange + new $22.4M tranche), and a Feb 2026 Consolidation Plan (further ~20% workforce cut, Redmond closure, $8-12M asset impairment).
scores.interpretation: Distress disclosure is self-corroborating: heavy ATM use (80.6M shares for $104M net), repeated convertible-note restructurings, multiple write-downs of Ibeo perception software and MOVIA L inventory, and Heuristic 10 fingerprint (additional 20% RIF + Orlando consolidation announced Feb 2026). PASS on the factual claim; this is a HIGH-severity negative for the equity thesis (going-concern + dilution funnel) but the disclosure itself is accurate.
